name: Benjamin Rosman

affiliations.role: Professor; Director of the MIND Institute

bio: Benjamin Rosman is a professor at the University of the Witwatersrand, director of the Wits MIND Institute and of its robotics and learning lab, and chief science officer of Lelapa AI. Rosman is a co-founder of Lelapa AI and of the Deep Learning Indaba, and research focuses on reinforcement learning and robotics. TIME named Rosman to its 2025 list of the 100 most influential people in AI.
